description: This file defines the Gnumeric reader class as part of the PhpSpreadsheet library. It provides functionality to determine if a file can be read as a Gnumeric spreadsheet, list worksheet names and info without fully loading the spreadsheet, and load and parse Gnumeric files into a Spreadsheet object. The class handles XML parsing, worksheet setup, cell data extraction, merged cells, autofilter, column and row dimensions, and named ranges specific to Gnumeric files.

classes.name: Gnumeric
classes.description: A class for reading Gnumeric spreadsheet files, capable of listing worksheet names/infos and loading spreadsheets into PhpSpreadsheet objects with support for Gnumeric-specific features.

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Checks if the given filename is a readable Gnumeric file based on presence of Gnumeric namespace.

methods.name: listWorksheetNames
methods.description: Returns the names of worksheets in the Gnumeric file without fully loading the spreadsheet.

methods.name: listWorksheetInfo
methods.description: Provides information about worksheets such as name, last column, rows, and columns without fully loading the spreadsheet.

methods.name: loadSpreadsheetFromFile
methods.description: Creates a new Spreadsheet instance and loads data from the specified Gnumeric file.

methods.name: loadIntoExisting
methods.description: Loads data from a Gnumeric file into an existing Spreadsheet object.

methods.name: gzfileGetContents
methods.description: Reads file contents, decompressing if necessary, and applies a security scan.

methods.name: processComments
methods.description: Processes cell comments in a worksheet, adding them to the active sheet.

methods.name: loadCell
methods.description: Loads an individual cell's data into the active sheet, handling formulas, data types, and formats.
